lessons.title: Practice Tuple Creation Indexing
lessons.description: Finish two functions. A tuple is written with parentheses and does not change. make_point(x, y) returns the tuple (x, y). get_x(point) returns the first item. make_point(10, 20) is (10, 20), and its x value is 10. The test checks that make_point(10, 20) equals (10, 20); get_x(p) equals 10.
learning_objectives: Marsh bakers recount crates before dawn, and create and index tuples.

tests.name: test_tuple_basics
tests.unittest_code:
def test_tuple_basics(self):
    p = make_point(10, 20)
    self.assertEqual(p, (10, 20))
    self.assertEqual(get_x(p), 10)

lessons.title: Practice Tisbury Treasure Hunt
lessons.description: Finish get_coordinate, convert_coordinate, compare_records, create_record and 1 more. Match coordinate records and clean data using tuple indexing, conversion, and unpacking. The test checks that get_coordinate(('Brass Spyglass', '4B')) equals '4B'; convert_coordinate('2F') equals ('2', 'F'); compare_records(('Brass Spyglass', '4B'), ('Seaside keep', ('4', 'B'), 'Blue')) equals True.
learning_objectives: Mesa wardens recount crates before dawn, and index and slice tuple elements.

tests.name: test_compare_records
test_create_record
test_clean_up
tests.unittest_code:
def test_clean_up(self):
    input_data = (
        ('Brass Spyglass', '4B', 'Seaside keep', ('4', 'B'), 'Blue'),
        ('Vintage Compass', '3D', 'Coastal cottage', ('3', 'D'), 'Yellow')
    )
    expected = "('Brass Spyglass', 'Seaside keep', ('4', 'B'), 'Blue')\n('Vintage Compass', 'Coastal cottage', ('3', 'D'), 'Yellow')\n"
    self.assertEqual(clean_up(input_data), expected)

source.name: Exercism Python Track — Tisbury Treasure Hunt
